data.benefits:
You can only apply for one role in one location each year, so take your time choosing the best fit for you. After completing the initial application form, these are the steps you can expect to take: 

Step 1: Complete the Discovery Portal 
  • This is our online assessment designed to evaluate your strengths and skills. 
  • It also gives you a feel for what it’s like to work at Accenture. 
  • You’ll receive a personal feedback report - whether you pass or not. 
Step 2: Interviews 

If you pass the assessment, you’ll be invited to interviews. These typically include: 
  • One interview with a recruiter 
  • One interview with a manager from the business area you applied to 
Step 3: Learn more about the process 
  • Visit our Assessments Portal for more details on what to expect at each stage.&

data.description:
💼 The Role at a Glance

On our Program & Project Management Graduate Programme, you’ll be trained and will help deliver impactful technology changes across a huge range of industries. Depending on your placement, you could be doing anything from project managing the rollout of new AI tools to analysing complex budgets for our clients. This is an opportunity to play a key role in how technology is shaping the world. 

You don’t need technical skills. In this role you’ll be utilising strong people skills, a curious mind and a real interest in the way technology is being used to shape the world.  

Life as a Program & Project Management Graduate
﻿
data.key_responsibilities:
• You will start your journey with some core training, teaching you the skills (including GenAI) that you’ll need to be a successful analyst at Accenture 
  • You will undergo some programme specific training giving you a strong grasp of the delivery lifecycle and how to operate in internal and client facing teams 
  • You will get the opportunity to gain industry recognised certifications in areas such as Cloud fundamentals and project management

data.description:
💼 The Role at a Glance

On our Technology Analyst Graduate Programme, you'll be at the heart of bringing innovative tech solutions to life for our clients. Whether you're supporting the build of a new cloud platform, helping test a new app, or mapping out the delivery plan for a digital transformation, you'll be part of a team making real change happen. 

This programme is ideal for graduates who enjoy applying their analytical skills. Whether these skills have been developed through your academic studies, work experience, extracurricular activities, or personal interests, this programme could be the launch pad for your career in Tech. 

Don’t know how to code? No problem! You won’t need to complete any technical assessments for this role. All you need is a passion and desire to build a career in technology – we’ll train you in the rest! 

Life as a Technology Analyst Graduate
﻿
